result.reason: The clause adds professional-and-workmanlike performance, material conformance, malicious-code protection, and a correction-or-refund remedy while preserving the unrelated disclaimer. However, it does not reach even the fallback because it provides no warranty periods (minimum 90 days for software and 30 days for services) and omits compliance with laws. It also does not expressly provide replacement as a remedy. The margin comment cannot cure these operative omissions, and the retained disclaimer text appears syntactically incomplete.
